name: Suzune
source:
Favorite food: Ice cream.
Disliked food: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Y%C5%8Dkan]Youkan[/url] (red bean jelly).
Favorite things: Cute things, stuffed toy animals, dogs, friendly people, people who like to play.
Disliked things: People who get angry easily.
Hobbies: Walking, going out.
Special skill: Playing.
